messages:
maria: FYI — Anchor AI reported a sudden increase in 502s to hosted endpoint in eu-west-1 right after our cert push at 09:12 UTC. Spike window ~09:15-09:40. Gateway logs show many "TLS handshake timed out".
ash: which customer / impact?
maria: anchor-ai-prod. approx 8% of requests in that 25m window.
samir: paste the gateway log snippet please
maria: sure

```
2026-03-15T09:16:04Z gw-12 Error TLS handshake timeout for upstream custapi-xxx (peer=10.3.2.5)
2026-03-15T09:16:04Z gw-12 Debug SNI: "anchor.ai-hosted.redwood"
2026-03-15T09:16:05Z gw-12 Debug OCSP stapling: responder_timeout
```

maria: customer says retries after ~30s usually succeed.
oncall-ops: any resolver noise around that time from probes?
ash: saw intermittent SERVFAILs from resolver-a (10.20.3.2) during 09:14-09:18. A subset of edges still fall back to system DNS instead of DoH after the recent rollout.
maria: here's a dig from probe that hit SERVFAIL

```
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> anchor.ai-hosted.redwood
;; global options: +cmd
;; Got SERVFAIL
```

samir: hypothesis: cert chain push + OCSP responder latency + resolver SERVFAIL -> some edge nodes attempted upstream connections that timed out during handshake because stapled OCSP wasn't available and resolver returned stale/failed IPs.
support_lead: did the cert push include a new intermediate? any ocsp responder hostname changes?
maria: yes new intermediate deployed at 09:12, OCSP stapling was enabled. We saw stapling workers report timeouts on some edges.

ash: metrics show ocsp_response_latency jumped to ~5s on affected workers, and TCP connect latency was normal — so likely handshake stall waiting on staple.
samir: we need repro steps support can run externally.
maria: repro steps we used:
1) curl -v https://anchor.ai-hosted.redwood/generate
   sometimes returns 502/TLS timeout
2) openssl s_client -connect gateway.eu-west-1.redwood:443 -servername anchor.ai-hosted.redwood
   sometimes hangs and ends with "handshake failure"

ash: sample curl output

```
$ curl -v https://anchor.ai-hosted.redwood/generate
* Connected to gateway.eu-west-1.redwood (52.19.24.18) port 443
* TLS handshake timeout
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) OpenSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to gateway.eu-west-1.redwood:443
```

oncall-ops: did we recently change resolver failover order? The DoH rollout might leave mixed configs during transition.
maria: DoH rollout happened last week; config gating should avoid mixed state but some proxies reverted to inproc resolver and then system resolver on failure.
samir: short-term mitigations?
ash: 1) restart ocsp-staple workers in eu-west-1 (low risk)
2) temporarily increase TLS handshake timeout on affected gateway pools (+2s) (medium risk)
3) adjust resolver priority on edges to prefer DoH while rollout finishes (low-medium)
support_lead: which to do now?
ash: restart stapling worker first, then adjust resolver priority on a couple subnets.

devops-bot: rolling restart: ocsp-staple-worker-eu-west-1 -> initiated by maria

maria: restarted worker and watching.
ash: ocsp_response_latency trending back to baseline; 502 spike tailing off in last 5 mins.
samir: DNS SERVFAILs dropped but occasional hits remain. I changed resolver priority on two problematic edge subnets to prefer DoH.
support_lead: action items:
- maria: monitor Anchor AI's error rate for 2h and confirm with them
- ash: audit edges still using system resolver and schedule config correction
- samir: draft 1-paragraph blurb for postmortem explaining interaction of cert rotation + OCSP stall + resolver fallback

maria: Anchor AI confirmed errors dropped from 8%->0.4% after the worker restart and resolver changes :thumbsup:

maria: attaching s_client and dig traces (redacted) in support ticket.

oncall-ops: follow-up: add an OCSP latency probe to the cert rollout playbook to catch responder slowdowns before we flip chains.
ash: +1. Also consider a rolling cert push with smaller blast radius.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions.
